correctness.rationale: For every prime-power q>=2 and degree cutoff d>=0, monic gcds give a unique collision factorization with two free common factors and a coprime residual pair. Exact polynomial Mobius coefficients 1,-q,0,... yield C_L=(q^(2L+1)-1)/(q-1), then N(a,b), whose sum agrees with known E. A pointwise-dominated mass coupling bounds TV by the removed mass R-W; geometric boundary and interior sums give 3q/((q^2-1)(d+1)). The weak limit follows; independent brute polynomial multiplication and gcd checks plus exact rational calculations corroborate the formulas.

value.rationale: Two monic gcds are intrinsic arithmetic invariants of an ordered zero-determinant polynomial matrix and their complete joint enumeration refines a newly studied natural energy statistic. The uniform-in-field TV estimate gives a structural probabilistic limit with a macroscopic uniform factor and tight signed-geometric difference, not a mere restatement of the known scalar count; the limit is applicable across all finite field orders and arbitrarily large degree cutoffs.
